id: ADC12-定时器事件触发-停止模式
title: ADC12 定时器事件触发（停止模式）
description: The following example configures ADC1 to be triggered by a TimerG instance 1s after the timer has been started while the device remains Stop mode. LED1 is set if ADC conversion is greater than 1.5V using window comparator feature.（SDK 例程：adc12_triggered_by_timer_event_stop）
